title: docs/test.md: state the source-owner 429 action in the committed-input refusal list
outcome: The launcher paragraph in docs/test.md that lists committed-input refusals before a run directory exists (around lines 1176-1181 at master 7c582a5d: "unavailable, refused or malformed source-owner metadata", and so on) also states what to do about an HTTP 429 refusal of the source-owner probe. The host allows two probes at once (ENGRAM_SOURCE_OWNER_PERMITS); the refusal leaves no per-run artifact or registration; the launching session reports it to its coordinator, who decides when to launch again. The wording matches the interrupted-before-first-record entry that w-f1559f4bd64c lands.
acceptance: The committed-input refusal list in docs/test.md states the action for an HTTP 429 source-owner probe refusal, consistent with the interrupted-before-first-record entry: no per-run artifact or registration, reported to the coordinator, who decides when to launch again, no unowned timed wait.
The independent review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding, and the full gate passes on the exact landed input.
